key.name: ring-radius
key.description: Radius in logical pixels of the ring's rounded corners; 0 for sharp corners. The inner corner radius is this minus the ring width.

key.name: ring-color-temperature
key.description: Color temperature in Kelvin of the ring light, from warm yellow (2700 K) to daylight white (6500 K).

key.name: brightness
key.description: Maximum opacity of the ring light, as a percentage.

key.name: ring-mode
key.description: How the ring is activated: 'auto' follows the camera, 'always' keeps the ring on, 'off' hides it.

key.name: show-quick-settings-toggle
key.description: Whether to show Ring Light control in GNOME Quick Settings.

key.name: excluded-monitors
key.description: Connector names of monitors that do not receive a ring.

key.name: cursor-transparency
key.description: Whether the ring fades out around the pointer so it never covers the cursor. Off by default so the light stays continuous during calls; the hole only appears while the pointer is on the ring band.

key.name: cursor-radius
key.description: Radius in logical pixels of the circle around the pointer where the ring fades out; 0 disables cursor avoidance.

key.name: cursor-fade
key.description: Soft-edge width of the cursor hole in logical pixels; 0 gives a hard circular edge.
